AlarakCounterStrikeItem.name: Counter-Strike
AlarakCounterStrikeItem.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 (+4% per level) damage. This ability will take over Alarak's Trait button.

AlarakDeadlyChargeSecondHeroic.name: Deadly Charge
AlarakDeadlyChargeSecondHeroic.description: After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies in his path. AlarakOverwhelmingPowerDiscordStrike.name: Overwhelming Power
AlarakOverwhelmingPowerDiscordStrike.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 40% Attack Speed and causes Basic Attacks to heal for 15% of the damage dealt, increased by 50% of Sadism's bonus when hitting Heroes. These effects last for 4 seconds.

AlarakRuthlessMomentum.name: Ruthless Momentum
AlarakRuthlessMomentum.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Telekinesis from 30 to 20. Telekinesis's cooldown recharges 100% faster while above 80% Health.

AlarakExtendedLightning.name: Extended Lightning
AlarakExtendedLightning.description: Reduce Sadism by 10%. Quest: Hit Heroes with the center of Lightning Surge. Reward: After hitting 5 Heroes, increase Lightning Surge's range by 20%. AlarakChaosReigns.name: Chaos Reigns
AlarakChaosReigns.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Discord Strike. Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, increase Discord Strike's damage by 60. Reward: After hitting 2 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage by 60. Reward: After hitting 3 Heroes with a single Discord Strike, increase its damage

AlarakNegativelyCharged.name: Negatively Charged
AlarakNegativelyCharged.description: Increase the Lightning Surge damage bonus to enemies between Alarak and his victim to 175%. Repeatable Quest: Each Hero hit by the center of Lightning Surge permanently increases the damage bonus by 5%.

AlarakShowofForce.name: Show of Force
AlarakShowofForce.description: Heroes hit with 3 of Alarak's Abilities within 2 seconds take an additional 61 damage and increase Sadism by 2%, stacking up to 20%. Sadism gained from Show of Force is lost on death.

AlarakDissonance.name: Dissonance
AlarakDissonance.description: Increase Discord Strike's Silence duration by 0.75 seconds.

AlarakHinderedMotion.name: Hindered Motion
AlarakHinderedMotion.description: Telekinesis Slows enemies by 30% for 3 seconds.

AlarakAppliedForce.name: Applied Force
AlarakAppliedForce.description: Reduce Sadism by 10%, but Telekinesis pushes 15% further and has 15% increased range.

AlarakDeadlyChargeFirstHeroic.name: Deadly Charge
AlarakDeadlyChargeFirstHeroic.description: After channeling, Alarak charges forward dealing 200 damage to all enemies in his path. AlarakHeroicAbilityCounterStrike.name: Counter-Strike
AlarakHeroicAbilityCounterStrike.description: Alarak targets an area and channels for 1 second, becoming Protected and Unstoppable. After, if he took damage from an enemy Hero, he sends a shockwave that deals 275 damage.

AlarakBladeoftheHighlord.name: Blade of the Highlord
AlarakBladeoftheHighlord.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes increase Sadism by 2% stacking up to 40%. Sadism gained from Blade of the Highlord is lost on death.

AlarakPureMalice.name: Pure Malice
AlarakPureMalice.description: Increase Sadism by 10% any time an allied Hero dies, up to 40%. Sadism gained from Pure Malice is lost on death.

AlarakRiteofRakShir.name: Rite of Rak'Shir
AlarakRiteofRakShir.description: Activate to mark an enemy Hero for 300 seconds. Hitting the marked Hero with Discord Strike increases Sadism by 3%. Killing the marked Hero increases Sadism by 5% and lowers the cooldown of Rite of Rak'Shir to 10 seconds. Sadism gained from Rite of Rak'Shir is lost on death.

AlarakLethalOnslaughtDiscordStrike.name: Lethal Onslaught
AlarakLethalOnslaughtDiscordStrike.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Discord Strike grants 50% of Sadism's damage bonus to Alarak's Basic Attacks for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh this duration.

AlarakLightningBarrage.name: Lightning Barrage
AlarakLightningBarrage.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with the center of Lightning Surge allows it to be cast again for free on a different primary target within the next 3 seconds. This free cast cannot benefit from Lightning Barrage.

AlarakMockingStrikes.name: Mocking Strikes
AlarakMockingStrikes.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Alarak's Basic Abilities by 1.5 seconds. This bonus is doubled against enemy Heroes who are Stunned, Silenced, Slowed, or Rooted.

AlarakWrathOfTheHighlord.name: Wrath of the Highlord
AlarakWrathOfTheHighlord.description: If Deadly Charge was the selected Heroic, Heroes hit by Deadly Charge take bonus damage from Alarak's Abilities equal to 75% of Sadism's bonus damage for 4 seconds. If Counter-Strike was the selected Heroic, its cooldown is reduced by 2.5 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by Alarak

AlarakMightOfTheHighlord.name: Might of the Highlord
AlarakMightOfTheHighlord.description: Alarak gains access to both of his Heroic Abilities. This can be activated to change which Ability occupies the Heroic slot, with the other Ability using the Trait slot.

AlarakLastLaugh.name: Last Laugh
AlarakLastLaugh.description: Activate to teleport to the chosen location and remove all Roots, Slows, and damage over time effects. If Alarak fails to hit enemy Heroes 3 times with Basic Abilities within 4 seconds of using Last Laugh, his Health is reduced to 1.

AlarakHastyBargain.name: Hasty Bargain
AlarakHastyBargain.description: Activate to permanently reduce Alarak's Sadism by 4% and reset the cooldowns of his Basic Abilities.
